# NDIS Provider Registration

> Independent Australian NDIS provider registration-assistance service operated by DGTG Pty Ltd, ABN 71 608 672 608. The service supports registration scoping, personalised policies and procedures, self-assessment evidence and independent audit preparation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the NDIA or the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-31
Canonical website: https://ndisproviderregistration.au
Telephone: 03 5911 1456
Email: sarch@rhodiumit.com.au
Base: Lynbrook VIC 3975, Australia
Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 am-5:00 pm Melbourne time
Delivery: Australia-wide online; Melbourne and South-East Melbourne appointments at client premises; no walk-in shopfront claimed.

## Service facts

- Published registration-support service fee: AUD $500.
- Independent approved quality auditor fees are separate and paid directly to the auditor engaged by the applicant.
- The service may help with registration scope, personalised documents, self-assessment preparation, application evidence and audit readiness.
- The service cannot approve, guarantee, fast-track or influence registration.
- The service does not conduct the independent registration audit.
- The NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission makes registration decisions.
